image_prompt: Masterpiece antique Victorian steel engraving and 19th-century copperplate woodcut etching in the authentic style of deluxe 1870s Longfellow poetry editions. A dramatic interior scene inside the soaring belfry tower of the Old North Church in Boston at midnight: massive hand-hewn oak timber rafters, diagonal bracing beams, and a giant bronze church bell, with a silhouetted patriot standing on the watch platform gazing out through the tall arched stone belfry window into the moonlit night as pigeons flutter from the shadowy beams.
caption: Inside the soaring timber belfry of the Old North Church: the heavy oak rafters, diagonal braces, and towering belfry arch framing the midnight watch.
